wiki_title.description: Title to show in the browser tab

wiki_lang.description: Default language code for the wiki

wiki_template.description: Template name to use for the wiki appearance

wiki_tagline.description: Tagline displayed in the header if the template supports it

wiki_sidebar.description: Name of the sidebar page in the root namespace

wiki_license.description: Creative Commons license used by the wiki

wiki_savedir.description: Directory where DokuWiki stores its data files

wiki_basedir.description: Base directory of the DokuWiki installation

wiki_baseurl.description: Full URL to the server including protocol; leave blank for autodetection

wiki_cookiedir.description: Path to use for cookies; leave blank to use basedir

wiki_dmode.description: Octal permission mode for newly created directories (e.g., 0755)

wiki_fmode.description: Octal permission mode for newly created files (e.g., 0644)

wiki_recent.description: Number of recent changes entries to show

wiki_recent_days.description: Number of days of recent changes to keep

wiki_breadcrumbs.description: Number of recently visited pages to show in breadcrumbs

wiki_fullpath.description: Show full path of the document or relative to datadir only (0 or 1)

wiki_dformat.description: Date format accepted by PHP's strftime() function

wiki_showuseras.description: How to display user names: 'loginname', 'username', 'email', or 'email_link'

wiki_toptoclevel.description: Level starting with and below to include in AutoTOC (max 5)

wiki_tocminheads.description: Minimum number of headlines required to build a TOC

wiki_deaccent.description: Handle accented characters in page names (0=keep, 1=deaccented, 2=romanize)

wiki_useheading.description: Use the first heading in a page as its name (0 or 1)

wiki_sneaky_index.description: Check namespace read permission in index view (0 or 1)

wiki_hidepages.description: Regexp for pages to skip from RSS, Search, and Recent Changes

wiki_autopasswd.description: Autogenerate passwords and email them to new users (0 or 1)

wiki_passcrypt.description: Password hashing method (smd5, md5, sha1, ssha, crypt, mysql, my411, bcrypt)

wiki_superuser.description: Admin user or @group or comma-separated list

wiki_manager.description: Manager user or @group or comma-separated list

wiki_profileconfirm.description: Require current password to confirm profile changes (0 or 1)

wiki_disableactions.description: Comma-separated list of actions to disable

wiki_auth_security_timeout.description: Time in seconds auth data is considered valid

wiki_securecookie.description: Never send HTTPS cookies via HTTP (0 or 1)

wiki_samesitecookie.description: SameSite attribute for cookies (Lax, Strict, None, or Empty)

wiki_remoteuser.description: Users/groups with access to remote interface (comma-separated)

wiki_remotecors.description: CORS origins for remote interfaces (asterisk to allow all)

wiki_usewordblock.description: Block spam based on words (0 or 1)

wiki_relnofollow.description: Add rel='ugc nofollow' to external links (0 or 1)

wiki_indexdelay.description: Seconds before allowing indexing after page creation (default 5 days)

wiki_mailguard.description: Method to obfuscate email addresses (visible, hex, or none)

wiki_iexssprotect.description: Check for JavaScript and HTML in uploaded files (0 or 1)

wiki_usedraft.description: Automatically save a draft while editing (0 or 1)

wiki_locktime.description: Maximum age for lockfiles in seconds (default 15 minutes)

wiki_cachetime.description: Maximum age for cache files in seconds (default 1 day)

wiki_target_wiki.description: Target window for internal wiki links

wiki_target_windows.description: Target window for Windows-style path links

wiki_refcheck.description: Check for references before deleting media files (0 or 1)

wiki_gdlib.description: GD Library version (0, 1, or 2; 2 tries autodetection)

wiki_fetchsize.description: Maximum size in bytes fetch.php may download from extern

wiki_subscribers.description: Enable change notice subscription support (0 or 1)

wiki_subscribe_time.description: Time in seconds after which digests/lists are sent

wiki_notify.description: Email address to send change notifications to

wiki_registernotify.description: Email address to send new user registration notifications to

wiki_mailfrom.description: Email address used as sender for outgoing mails

wiki_mailreturnpath.description: Email address used as return path for bounce mails

wiki_mailprefix.description: Prefix for the subject line of outgoing mails

wiki_logretain.description: Number of days of logs to keep

wiki_sitemap.description: Create a Google sitemap? How often? In days.

wiki_rss_type.description: Type of RSS feed to provide (rss, rss1, rss2, atom, atom1)

wiki_rss_linkto.description: What page RSS entries link to (diff, page, rev, current)

wiki_rss_content.description: What to put in RSS items (abstract, diff, htmldiff, html)

wiki_rss_media.description: What should be listed in RSS (both, pages, media)

wiki_rss_update.description: Update the RSS feed every n seconds (default 5 minutes)

wiki_rss_show_summary.description: Add revision summary to title (0 or 1)

wiki_rss_show_deleted.description: Show deleted items in RSS (0 or 1)

wiki_updatecheck.description: Automatically check for new releases (0 or 1)

wiki_useslash.description: Use slash instead of colon in URLs (0 or 1)

wiki_sepchar.description: Word separator character in page names

wiki_canonical.description: Use full canonical http:// URLs (0 or 1)

wiki_fnencode.description: Encoding method for filenames (url, safe, utf-8)

wiki_autoplural.description: Try non-plural form of nonexistent files (0 or 1)

wiki_compression.description: Compression method for old revisions (gz, bz2, or empty for off)

wiki_gzip_output.description: Use gzip content encoding for output (0 or 1)

wiki_compress.description: Strip whitespaces and comments from Styles and JavaScript (0 or 1)

wiki_cssdatauri.description: Maximum byte size of small images to embed into CSS

wiki_send404.description: Send HTTP 404 status for nonexistent pages (0 or 1)

wiki_renderer_xhtml.description: Renderer to use for main page generation

wiki_readdircache.description: Cache time in seconds for readdir operation (0 to deactivate)

wiki_search_nslimit.description: Limit search to current X namespaces (0 for unlimited)

wiki_search_fragment.description: Default fragment search behavior (exact or fuzzy)

wiki_dnslookups.description: Allow IP to hostname lookups (0 or 1)

wiki_jquerycdn.description: Use a CDN for delivering jQuery (0 or 1)

wiki_proxy_ssl.description: Use SSL for proxy connection (0 or 1)

wiki_proxy_except.description: Comma-separated list of hosts to bypass the proxy

run_cleanup_default.description: Default value for RUN_CLEANUP variable in /etc/default/dokuwiki

cleanup_maxdays_default.description: Default value for CLEANUP_MAXDAYS variable in /etc/default/dokuwiki

remove_attic_default.description: Default value for REMOVE_REVISIONS variable in /etc/default/dokuwiki

update_blacklist_default.description: Default value for UPDATE_BLACKLIST variable in /etc/default/dokuwiki
